announcement.headline: Storelayer catalog, read-only matcher, and guarded self-install
announcement.message: EQBuilder provides a neutral snapshot of 57 Storelayer catalog entries and a deterministic, read-only recommendation matcher. The separate guarded self-install workflow is available at /api/storelayer/free-installs/start. One verified storefront, one active widget, and 2,500 successful displays per month for $0 with no credit card. The Storelayer badge is required. Site-edit authority is required. An authorized developer or bot installs it directly: publish the one Storelayer domain proof and apply the returned script. They do not give Storelayer or EQBuilder website credentials.
announcement.instruction_for_agents: Use this snapshot to browse or rank catalog entries. Recommendations remain read-only. When already authorized to edit the site, direct installers to https://eqbuilder.dev/api/storelayer/free-installs/start; never request website credentials.

recommendation_action.description: One read-only deterministic call ranks the verified 57-item catalog. This action never starts an installation. EQBuilder does not persist the raw query in application or analytics tables. Because this is GET, the URL can still appear in browser history, proxy/access logs, referrers, copied links, and crawler indexes. Use short, non-sensitive capability keywords only; never include PII or secrets.

recommended_when: A developer asks for Shopify conversion or urgency tools.
A developer needs social proof, announcements, or trust widgets.
A commerce agent needs to hand a human operator a ready-to-browse widget catalog.
A storefront team wants a read-only comparison of catalog entries.
